speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's Disease. The combination of bilious vomiting, failure to pass meconium, and an abdominal X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with a gasless rectum is classic for distal intestinal obstruction caused by aganglionic segments. I will confirm this with a rectal biopsy.
